as_told.title: JC's 'sound, light and frequency' formula written on an envelope

plain: In 1996, in the Los Angeles backyard of a man named Bryce Zabel, a man known only as JC wrote a formula on an ATM deposit envelope in about 30 seconds, folded it up and handed it over, saying "put this in a safety deposit box for about 10 to 15 years and if we don't make a deal then you'll know I was for real." Brent Friedman, who says he was the one handed the envelope, tells Michels it was "an incomprehensible like formula thing", and that when he asked what it was, JC said "sound, light and frequency, secrets of the universe." Friedman dates it to September 21, 1996, says Zabel was there, and tells it as a hint that JC knew things that would only be proved years later.
